summary: Customer is unhappy with the credit card reward program change.

intents.keywords: हेलो मैं शुभम गुप्ता मेरे क्रेडिट कार्ड का रिवॉर्ड ... बदल गया है।

issues.issue: Customer is unhappy with the new reward program.
issues.reason(s): Customer preferred the old reward program.

intents.actions of agent: Agent checked the details and informed the customer that the new program is as per bank policy. Agent offered to email the details and raise a request for the old program.
intents.Process Request: Request to revert to the old reward program.
intents.resolution: Agent will email the details of the new program and raise a request to revert to the old program and provide an update.
